name: Social Button
description: Sign-in buttons for 24 common providers, with their marks.

props.name: provider
props.description: Selects the mark, its colour and the label "Continue with {Name}".

props.name: variant
props.description: Outline is the secondary button with the mark in its own colour (or the text colour where that colour would be too faint). Solid fills with the provider's colour. Icon is a square holding only the mark, labelled for assistive tech.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of the mark and blocks presses.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the button is pressed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of Button.
